died.name: Sergey Volkonsky
died.cause: he died mid-sentence as he was writing his memoirs

died.name: Luigi Pirandello
died.last_words: The hearse, the horse, the driver and-enough!

died.name: Paul Morgan
died.cause: said prior to collapsing and dying of exhaustion in Buchenwald concentration camp
died.last_words: I am sick – I have a fever...

died.name: Damon Runyon
died.last_words: You can keep the things of bronze and stone and give me one man to remember me just once a year.

died.name: Karl Barth
died.cause: over the telephone to his friend Eduard Thurneysen
died.last_words: God sits in the regiments! That is why I am not afraid. Stay confident in also the darkest moments! Let us hope not fall, the hope for all people, for all the peoples of the world. God let us not fall, not a single one of us and all of us together. It is governed.

born.name: Emily Dickinson
born.last_words: I must go in, for the fog is rising. (when offered a drink of water) Oh, is that all it is?
